description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData to query the byte hit ratio of one or more domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData查询域名的字节命中率（命中字节百分比）
name: DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name.

If you do not specify this parameter, data for all your accelerated domain names is queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，仅支持单个域名查询。

不填默认查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity to query data, in seconds.

Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported time granularity varies based on the specified time range. For more information, see the Supported time granularities section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见上方的支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries, in seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range
